thread:
maria: Pushed a new Grafana dashboard for GPU sensor calibration + fan/power interplay. trying to correlate GPU temp spikes with power capping events. link: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/gpu-sensor-calib?orgId=1 :eyes:
kevin: Nice. Can you add a template var for region and for model_type? makes comparison easier across racks.
maria: good call — added ${region} and ${model} vars. Also added a panel with promql:
```
max_over_time(nvml_gpu_temp_celsius[5m])
```
but not sure if that's the right aggregation for spike detection.
jamal: For spike detection use increase() or calculate derivative:
```
max_over_time(rate(nvml_gpu_temp_celsius[5m])[1m:])
```
or use histogram_quantile for p95.
kevin: Also set alert to 'for 2m' and use 'avg_over_time' with 90th percentile. Avoid instant.
sasha: Watch out: sampling at 15s increases prometheus ingest. maybe use pushgateway for high res? :grimacing:   
ops-bot: dashboard 'GPU Sensor Calibration v2' updated by maria (deploy-id: d-9921) :rocket:
maria: noted about prometheus cost — lowered scrape to 30s for temp but kept 15s for fan/power counters. Ben (SRE) suggested keep 1m for p95 panels.
ben: yeh, keep counters at 15s for delta accuracy, temps at 30s. Also add a derived panel for 'KV cache miss rate' to explain latency spikes — query: `increase(kvcache_misses_total[5m]) / increase(kvcache_lookups_total[5m])`.
kevin: Can we add a per-node annotation from provisioning events? e.g., annotate with 'node-drain' 'node-up' from our events index.
maria: added annotations to the time range selector. Also added a 'cost impact' note in the dashboard header: estimated token-hours lost during capping = manual calc for now.
jamal: LGTM. small nit: panel title 'GPU temp, max' -> 'GPU temp (max 5m)'. :+1:
maria: thanks — will iterate, planning to flip to default next week after one week of monitoring.
